en-IN.name: Ramesh Dude (Hearth)
en-IN.summary: Relays what you say to your own home hub and reads back its answer.
en-IN.description: Ramesh Dude (Hearth) forwards a spoken command to a hub running in your own home, which decides what to do with a local model and a fixed list of allowed tools, then speaks the hub's short reply. Requires your own Hearth hub. Development use only.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask ramesh dude how much space is left
Alexa, ask ramesh dude to ping

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development-only skill. Requires the owner's Hearth hub to be running; without it the skill answers that the hub did not reply in time.
